title: Symphony Registry - Melody® Best Practice Study
summary: The prospective Symphony study investigates the long-term function and durability of the Melody® Valve after implantation under "best practice criteria" over a period of five years.
conditions: Tetralogy of Fallot with pulmonary stenosis or pulmonary atresia or absent pulmonary valve Transposition of the Great ArteriesTruncus ArteriosusAortic Valve deseaseIsolated Pulmonary stenosiswith: predominant ore pure regurgitationMixed stenotic and regurgitation orpredominant or pure stenosiswith indication for valve replacement with a Melody valve

interventions.name:

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1.	Age 12 years and older
2.	Successful implantation of a Melody® valve under Best Practice conditions
3.	Residual peak to peak gradient across the new implanted Melody® valve must not exceed 15mmHg measured invasively.
4.	Follow up treatment and surveillance planned according to Best Practice
5.	Patient who is willing to complete the Follow up Visits in the treating hospital
6.	Informed consent by patient and/or legal representatives
Exclusion criteria:
1.	Landing zone after pre-stenting less than 22 mm diameter
2.	Severe immune deficiency (e.g. di George)
3.	Significant immunosuppressive medication
4.	History of Endocarditis
5.	actual dental infection (dental report not older than three months   ) 
6.	Actual infectious skin diseases
